evidence.description: Analyst flagged that several cards this month show purchases from the same unusual device profile
Device profile linked to transaction 3478561 is shared across 4 separate customer cards within a 6-day window
None of the 4 linked cards share a billing region, email domain, or prior relationship — device is the only common element
No matching prior case for this exact device-sharing pattern; does not fit any of the 5 documented fraud patterns

case.reasoning: This activity does not cleanly match card testing, CNP, out-of-region, or account takeover: the shared element across unrelated customers is a single device profile, which is closer to a coordinated fraud ring than any documented pattern. Per policy R9, this is classified as undocumented rather than forced into an existing category. The shared-device evidence across 4 distinct cards meets the bar under R6 for treating this as a coordinated origin.

sar.reason: Coordinated/undocumented pattern connecting multiple customers through a shared device (policy R9 and 3a)
sar.summary: A single device profile was used across 4 unrelated customer cards within a 6-day window, none sharing any other connection. This does not match a documented fraud pattern and is reported as coordinated, undocumented activity. All 4 connected cards placed under monitoring; case opened; report filed.

initial.justification: Policy 3a: open a case once fraud probability reaches 0.30 to begin tracking the analyst-flagged pattern across cards.

final.justification: Policy R6/R9: the shared device profile links 4 cards with no other common element — name the shared device, place all connected cards under monitoring, and (per R9) FILE_REPORT and ESCALATE_TO_ANALYST are also recommended alongside this action since the pattern is coordinated and undocumented.

evidence_requests: Full transaction list for all 4 cards linked to the shared device profile
stop_reason: The shared-device link across 4 unrelated cards is strong, graph-confirmed evidence; sufficient to act and escalate without further evidence gathering.
